note_zh: Aneo 網站到 2026-10 仍只有 2025-12-19 的新聞稿（嚴重結冰造成多部風機葉片受損、修理中、另行通知前封閉）；專案頁仍寫「營運中」（2021 年、130 MW、31 部 V117 4.2 MW）。2026 年沒有找到重新開放的公告或事故原因報告（Aneo 中英文新聞頁、Namdalsavisa、Flatangernytt、TU 都查過）。紀錄維持營運中；可順便補上機型。
note_en: As of Oct 2026 Aneo’s site still has only the 19 Dec 2025 release (heavy icing damaged blades on several turbines; repairs under way; closed until further notice); the project page still says ‘in operation’ (2021, 130 MW, 31 Vestas V117 of 4.2 MW). No 2026 reopening notice or published root cause was found (Aneo news in Norwegian and English, Namdalsavisa, Flatangernytt, TU). The record stays operating; the turbine model can be filled in.
why: No 2026 owner update or published cause; beta.aneo.com TLS error; Flatangernytt and Namdalsavisa paywalled.

sources.quote: Until further notice, we will keep the wind farm closed to access.
There are 31 Vestas V117 turbines installed, each with 4.2 MW.

note_zh: 到 2026-10 為止，最新的是 9 月與 GE Vernova 和解時開發商說「所有風機都能發電」，當地媒體指出不清楚是否已全部完成試運轉；Unitil 的 SEC 季報（4/24 部分容量商轉、預計第三季達到全容量）在 sec.gov 讀不到（403）。查不到全部 62 部全面商轉的公告。
note_en: As of Oct 2026 the latest is the developer’s statement at the September GE Vernova settlement that ‘all turbines are capable of producing power’, with local press noting it is unclear whether they are fully commissioned; Unitil’s SEC 10-Q (commercial operation on 24 April at less than full capacity, full capacity expected in Q3) cannot be read on sec.gov (403). No announcement of full commercial operation of all 62 turbines was found.

sources.quote: Vineyard Wind said “all turbines are capable of producing power,” though it is not clear whether that means they are fully commissioned.

note_zh: 開發商時程：2026 年中首度發電、2026 年底 100 部全部試運轉完成、全面運轉；2026-06-10 裝完最後一部，之後沒有全面運轉的公告。
note_en: Developer timeline: first power mid-2026 and all 100 turbines fully commissioned, fully operational, in late 2026; the last turbine went in on 10 June 2026 and no full-operation announcement has followed.

sources.quote: Late 2026 All 100 turbines fully commissioned. Offshore converter platform fully commissioned. Sofia is fully operational.

note_zh: 2026-09-11 時 62 部只裝了 31 部、夏季 5 部投入運轉，預計年底前全部投運。
note_en: On 11 Sep 2026 only 31 of 62 turbines were installed and 5 had entered service over the summer; full commissioning expected by year-end.

sources.quote: installant 31 des 62 éoliennes. Cinq ont été mises en service durant l’été , après une série de tests, alors que la mise en service complète du parc normand est attendue d’ici la fin de l’année.

note_zh: Northland 2026-10-07：76 部全部裝好、三分之一以上在發電，正在試運轉，預計 2026 年商轉。
note_en: Northland, 7 Oct 2026: all 76 turbines installed, over one-third generating, commissioning under way, commercial operation expected in 2026.

sources.quote: All 76 turbines are now installed, with over one-third currently generating power.
